parsed_output.overall_summary: In this short basketball tutorial, creator @db3workouts demonstrates five fundamental yet highly effective dribbling moves designed to beat defenders. The video showcases the In N Out, Delay Thru, Push Cross, Quick Split Thru, and Cross Jab in a clear, step-by-step visual format on an indoor court. Each move is performed with high intensity to show how it looks in a game-like scenario. The takeaway is a set of reliable ball-handling techniques that players of all levels can use to improve their offensive game.

people.description: Male basketball trainer wearing a blue t-shirt, black athletic shorts, and white basketball shoes.

takeaways.statement: Simple, fundamental dribbling moves are often more effective than complex ones for beating defenders.
Mastering change of pace and footwork (like splits and jabs) is essential for effective ball handling.

items.name: In N Out
items.details: A fake crossover move where the ball is brought inward and then quickly pushed back out to the same side.

items.name: Delay Thru
items.details: A change-of-pace move involving a hesitation before dribbling between the legs.

items.name: Push Cross
items.details: An aggressive crossover where the ball is pushed forward and across the body to gain ground.

items.name: Quick Split Thru
items.details: A rapid between-the-legs move performed while the feet are in a split stance to explode past a defender.

items.name: Cross Jab
items.details: Combining a crossover with a sharp jab step in the opposite direction to freeze the defender.
